headline: 10 Solana program addresses catalogued across core, liquidity, and interface layers; Squads multisig admin confirmed but address not surfaced

findings.text: D1: Solana has no EVM-compatible block explorer with name-tag search; solscan.io and explorer.solana.com are the canonical explorers but could not be directly searched by name-tag in this run due to tool-call limits. Program IDs obtained from official docs and GitHub instead. Recorded as D1-offchain.

D2: Official 'Programs & Security' page at docs.exponent.finance/user-documentation/security.md lists 5 core programs and 5 interface programs with their mainnet Solana program IDs. Set as deployed_contracts_doc.

D3: Audit page at docs.exponent.finance/user-documentation/audits-bug-bounty lists 25 audit reports across 6 firms (OtterSec, Offside Labs, Sec3, Certora, Accretion, Adevar Labs) covering exponent_core, exponent_clmm, exponent_orderbook, exponent_vault, exponent_tranching, and integration standards. All reports hosted in github.com/exponent-finance/exponent-audits. No scope address tables extracted as tool-call budget was exhausted before fetching PDFs; recorded as D3 unknown.

D4: GitHub org has 3 public repos: exponent-core (Rust), exponent-audits, strategy-recipes (TypeScript). exponent-core README confirms mainnet Program ID ExponentnaRg3CQbW6dqQNZKXp7gtZ9DGMp1cwC4HAS7, on-chain program hash e584d8035cbe411f6dc3a24bdcd32a29e4bf953569c1c4971b23c03793a16b3c, deployed commit hash 7011d1b46b542611543f8ed21836b165f2ab75ac. No broadcast/deploy artifacts with additional addresses found in main branch listing.
D5: Protocol is Solana-only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration needed.
D6: No factory pattern identified in fetched docs. Markets are created by the core program; no factory enumeration endpoint was accessible in this run.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: 5 core programs classified as 'other' (Solana programs, not EVM contracts); 5 interface programs as 'other'; admin multisig via Squads referenced in docs but address not surfaced — recorded as unknown.

D8: All 10 program IDs trace to fetched URL docs.exponent.finance/user-documentation/security.md and 1 (Exponent Core) additionally confirmed in github.com/exponent-finance/exponent-core README. Squads multisig address not confirmed in any fetched source — excluded from admin_addresses.

rationale.verdict: Walked official docs, GitHub org (3 repos), and audit index. Catalogued 10 Solana program addresses (5 core, 5 interface) from the canonical programs & security page. Squads multisig is confirmed to exist but its specific address was not surfaced in any fetched page; on-chain reads were not possible due to Solana chain not being supported by the DeFiPunkd read API (chainId not in supported list). grading_basis set to mixed because docs and GitHub were fetched but on-chain verification was not possible.

protocol_metadata.about: Exponent is a Solana-native yield exchange where users can strip yield-bearing assets into Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT), enabling fixed-rate income positions, leveraged yield exposure, and interest rate speculation. The protocol operates via three primary trading venues: a concentrated liquidity AMM (CLMM), a limit order book, and strategy vaults that automate portfolio construction. It also supports risk tranching, splitting yield assets into senior and junior tranches. Admin parameters — including program upgrades and fee settings — are governed by a Squads multisig of core contributors rather than a single private key.
